Name: Saloon Cover
Author: ThaleTheGreat
Description:
[size=3]This is a simple mod that adds a cover charge to enter the Saloon after 8pm. That's it. That's all it does.[/size]

[size=3]There are options to change the time, day, cost and a couple other options. [/size]

[b][size=3]All of my mods and their source code are on [url=https://github.com/ThaleTheGreat/ThalesStardewValleyMods]GitHub[/url][/size][/b]

Manifest.Name: Saloon Cover
Manifest.Description: Adds a bouncer inside the Stardrop Saloon with configurable cover charge time, price, and days.
Manifest.Author: ThaleTheGreat
